name: review-fixes-a

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: engine::tests::a_fixed_cache_at_max_with_the_drafter_boots_and_is_not_subtracted_twice + a_fixed_cache_on_a_box_one_gib_too_small_is_refused_by_name + an_auto_cache_leaves_the_floor_and_the_variable_part (fix 1; the first fails with the double subtraction put back)
memory::memory_the_plan_prices_exactly_the_listed_buffers (named items incl. EXL3 columns and top-k partials) + the engine plan pins (fix 5)
stale comments and fragments reworded; dims::device_constant_gaps and its test removed (fixes 7, 8)
backend tests: window limits, commit validation, wrong row count, fatal step, FailRestoreLate, failed prefill after begin (fix 8)
engine tests: drafter plan 18,576 B/token, prefill/window clamps, pool below one context, admission at 1,048,576 with 16,388 pages (fix 8)
the third token of a round and the reasoning count (fix 8)
bootstrap with the shipping defaults (spec dspark, cache on, vision on) boots
max with --prefix-cache-mib 12288 (drafter on, vision on) boots, 16,388 pages, cache 12.00 GiB

tests.bin: exactness.py record + diff + concurrent (node-1, drafter on)
tests.filter: replies sha256 f7975a6c...433d, identical to the pin; concurrent == solo
dump c25f9876...c45c0 twice; chunk widths a105f245...f41a

commands: run_profile.sh LABEL PROFILE=bootstrap | PROFILE=max PREFIX_CACHE=12288 | PROFILE=max PREFIX_CACHE=auto (the controller's defaults otherwise: --spec dspark, vision on)
./inkling2mini.sh start; exactness.py record OUT --max-tokens 128; diff PIN OUT; concurrent --max-tokens 64; stop
